summary: Mixed VB6 legacy patterns with modern Python conventions. VB6 uses Hungarian notation and event-driven architecture. Python follows PEP standards with agent-based architecture.

rules.rule: VB6 controls use Hungarian notation prefixes (frm, txt, cmd, lbl)
Python agent modules use snake_case with descriptive names
VB6 forms use BEGIN/END blocks with nested control definitions
Python modules organize imports with standard library first, then relative imports
JSON schemas use $schema, $id, and structured validation rules
counterexamples: simple object validation without schema metadata

lint_recommendations: Implement VB6 to C# naming convention mapping (Hungarian to PascalCase)
Add Python type hints to all agent method signatures
Enforce consistent JSON schema validation across all API endpoints
Standardize error handling patterns across agent implementations
scaffold_templates: ASP.NET Core form template with VB6 control mapping
Entity Framework model template for MS Access to PostgreSQL migration
Python agent base class template with standardized interfaces
JSON schema template for modernization artifacts
